title: Loop Unswitching Candidate (Invariant Conditional inside Loop)
pattern: An `if-else` block inside a loop where the condition variable is constant throughout the loop's entire execution.
why_bad: It forces the CPU to evaluate the conditional branch on every iteration, wasting cycles on branch prediction checks and preventing loop optimizations.
detection: An `if` statement whose conditional expression depends strictly on loop-invariant variables.
counterexample: Loop executes very few times (e.g., < 5 iterations). `Context-dependent`.
fix: Place the conditional check outside the loop, wrapping two independent loop blocks: `if (mode == FAST) { for ... } else { for ... }`.
